metadata.title: Download Nebula
metadata.description: You need your own copy of Super Mario Galaxy.

page.paragraph_2: You need your own copy of Super Mario Galaxy.

current.paragraph_1: Nebula v1.0.2 for Windows, released 27 October 2026.
current.paragraph_2: Download Nebula-Setup.exe under Assets on the release page.

platforms.paragraph_1: Windows 10 (1803 or newer) or Windows 11, 64-bit. Windows on ARM runs the x64 version.
platforms.paragraph_2: x64 and ARM64, including Steam Deck. Needs glibc 2.38 or newer, for example Ubuntu 24.04 or Fedora 39. Installs from the .tar.gz package with install.sh.
platforms.paragraph_3: macOS 12 or newer, on Apple silicon and Intel Macs.
platforms.paragraph_4: Android 12 or newer, 64-bit ARM, Vulkan 1.1. Touch controls and controllers.
platforms.paragraph_5: An iPhone and iPad version is in development.

before.paragraph_1: Nebula includes no game files. You need Super Mario Galaxy for Wii, North America (RMGE01), as an ISO, RVZ or extracted folder.

footer.paragraph_1: A little closer to the stars.
footer.paragraph_2: © 2026 keepvaibin. Nebula is free software under the GNU GPL v3. Super Mario Galaxy, Wii and Nintendo are trademarks of Nintendo. Nebula is not affiliated with Nintendo.
